content.title: Belve — Inner Tribe Records
content.text: BELVE BELVE is a hip-hop artist and rapper based in Detroit, originally from Grand Rapids, Michigan. He has built a profile in the underground rap scene with a sound that blends sharp lyricism and dynamic beats, often collaborating with diverse producers and vocalists. BELVE released the project Belve 2 on Inner Tribe Records on February 18, 2022, featuring tracks like Loosie, Right Time (feat. Jenna Camille) and Tiger Uppercut (feat. Flowz4Daze), showcasing his versatility and connection to both Detroit and international hip-hop communities. BELVE releases BELVE releases
